sentences.en: Surely the most curious of sources consulted is Mankind Quarterly.
sentences.zh: 当然，最奇怪的信息来源是《人类季度刊》。

sentences.en: Brian barely has enough money so he consulted his parents.
sentences.zh: 布赖恩手头拮据，所以他向父母求助了。

sentences.en: I'll consult a doctor as I have a bad cold.
sentences.zh: 我得去看医生了，因为我感冒很严重。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：不顾侮辱（insult），不耻请教（consult）
